verdict.rationale: Notte has a public pricing page with a no-card trial and a plan comparison table (e.g. bring-your-own-keys), so some pricing is visible before committing. However, a community user reports the page lists credit allotments without explaining what a credit buys, so per-task or per-browser-hour costs are opaque. Missing for 10: clear per-task or per-browser-hour unit pricing, an explanation of what a credit covers, and documented rate and concurrency limits.
